Indoor window treatments

Zebra & Banded Shades in Palm Beach County

Two layers of alternating sheer and solid bands. Offset them for filtered light, or line them up for more privacy, all in one shade.

Get a Free Consultation Call 561-332-8091

We bring samples to your home so you can compare options at your own windows.

Is it a fit?

Where zebra & banded shades work well

  • Rooms that need daylight and privacy at different times
  • One shade instead of layering two products
  • A modern, tailored look
  • Bedrooms and living spaces that face the street
Ask about zebra & banded shades

Good to know before you choose

Privacy, not blackout
Lining up the solid bands gives privacy, but small amounts of light still pass along the band edges.
Fabric choice
Band width and fabric weight change the look and how much light comes through. We'll bring samples to compare.
Operation
Cordless and motorized versions are available on many models, which helps in homes with kids or pets.
How it works

Three steps to finished zebra & banded shades

  1. Consultation at your home

    We bring samples, look at your windows in real light, and talk through what you need.

  2. Measurement and a written proposal

    Each opening is measured, and you get the products, options, and price in writing.

  3. Installation and walkthrough

    Our own installers fit, adjust, and explain everything before they leave.

Questions

Zebra & Banded Shades questions

How are zebra shades different from roller shades?

A roller shade is one layer of fabric. A zebra shade has two layers of banded fabric that slide past each other, so you can adjust light without raising the shade.

Are zebra shades blackout?

Usually not. They're best for privacy and light control. For a very dark room, a blackout roller or lined drapery works better.

Do they work on large windows?

Yes, within the size limits of the product. Very wide openings may be split into more than one shade. We'll confirm when we measure.
